FULL TEXT:
UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF LAWS
PANJAB UNIVERSITY,REGIOANL CENTRER LUDHIANA
ADVERTISEMENT FOR THE FACULTY POSITIONS IN THE SUBJECT OF
LAW
Faculty positions No. of
seats
Honorarium Duration*
Guest Faculty (Law) 01 Rs. 1500/- per lecture
subject to maximum of
Rs. 50,000/- per month
(subject to PU Rules)
Odd Semester of
session 2025-26
Minimum Qualification is as per UGC/P.U. norms.
(https://www.ugc.gov.in/pdfnews/5323630_New_Draft_UGCRegulation-
2018-9-2.pdf )
All the applicants are advised to send/submit hard copy of their applications to
the Director, University Institute of Laws, Panjab University, Regional
Centre Ludhiana along with all self attested copies of their certificates and
other relevant documents including publications for verification along with the
duly filled application form and template pages 1 to 11
(https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.pdf)
on or before 23rd September, 2025 till 4:00 p.m. Late applications will not
be considered and will stand rejected.
Important Instructions:
1. At the time of interview physical presence of the candidate is mandatory. The
candidates are required to bring all the supporting
documents/certificates/publications in original.
2. The candidates shall have to give an undertaking that he/she will not draw any
fellowship/stipend or any financial assistance from any agency till they are
teaching at University Institute of Laws, Panjab University, R e g i o n a l C e n t r e
L u d h i a n a as a Guest Faculty.
3. documents or soft copies duly self-attested by electronic mode (Email) at
dirpurcldh@pu.ac.in
4. Working hours for the appointee will be 9.00 am to 5.00pm (Monday to Friday).
5. The candidate shall have to undertake that he/she will not draw any fellowship/stipend or
any financial assistance from any agency and will do the same till they are teaching at UIL,
P.U. Regional Centre, Ludhiana.
6. Candidates shortlisted will be intimated about the date and timings for the interview by
email only. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
7. The candidates who had submitted the form and documents via Email need to bring the
hard copies of the form and the self attested documents at the time of Interview.
Sd/-
Director
P.U. Regional Centre, Ludhiana
